Orsolya legt fünfmal nacheinander die Ka: Orsolya lays down the card "The Locked House" five times in a row. Her hands are shaking. "I know what people think of me. But even a bad lie should change now and then."
Orsolya schiebt beim beaufsichtigten Bes: During the supervised visit Orsolya slides five identical cards across the table. "Price locked me up, and now my cards do the same to everyone who asks them." Her old card board is with a stall landlord at the Night Market; she asks you to look there.

Pratt hat seine Medaillen in ein Tuch ge: Pratt has wrapped his medals in a cloth. "A certain Mr Voss is selling shares in a charitable hospital lottery. The hospital doesn't exist, and I feel colleagues should set each other limits."

Rußgeist im Lohnschlot: Soot Ghost in the Wage Chimney

Tam holds the lantern with both hands. "Since the bell I don't trust any quiet night. Emil over there keeps painting the same lit window, but behind the wall there's no room."

Terns Schwester bestellte die Retusche z: Tern's sister ordered the retouch to comfort their mother, without Ada's knowledge.
Unter dem Boden wühlt ein Knäuel nasser: Beneath the floor a tangle of wet animals squirms. No tails have grown together; a stolen bundle of wire runs through tallow and rags. As long as you don't bump the grate, the animals stop biting. The drain leads out to the empty coal yard.
Unter dem Schlachthof wird ein gefangene: Under the slaughterhouse a trapped swarm is declared a monster.
Unter einer schwarzen Plane sitzen drei: Under a black tarpaulin sit three bandaged pigeons. Len Fallow kneels beside them and shows you his unhurt hands. "The wounds are the birds', the soot is from the jetty. My employers won't tolerate animals in the house, and I need the position."

Voss die Rückzahlung abnehmen und alle A: Make Voss repay and compensate all the investors.

Wren faltet die Hände. „Der Nachtrag nen: Wren folds her hands. "The codicil names my administration, so it names me. I decide who keeps the money, even if others decide on my place in the house." You note the claim word for word, without excusing her earlier deeds with it.

„Am Nordtor liegt sein alter Fahrschein: "His old ticket lies on the bench at the North Gate. Ask at the cemetery about the name on it, then we'll decide what arriving means."
„Am Wartungsgitter kannst du sehen, was: "At the maintenance grate you can see what holds them together. You can drive the swarm off or loosen the wires and let it out through the drain. My bill comes out differently."
„Die Manschette habe ich aufgehoben, dor: "I kept the cuff, there by the laundry basket. Look for the red stuff at the slaughterhouse and the soot at the harbour. Nobody pays me a stain surcharge for stories."
„Frag erst Emil am Altmarkt, dann sieh d: "Ask Emil at the Old Market first, then look at the walled-up break corner in the foundry. I'll do my round once you know what's waiting for me there."
„Im Kehrbuch steht, wem der Schlot frühe: "The sweeping book says who the chimney used to belong to. The widow already paid for the candles; they're lying next to it. You can coax the thing out or drive it out by force."
„Im Kontor liegt der Nachtrag, im Waisen: "The codicil is at the counting house, the old receipt copy at the orphanage. Hear Wren's claim and connect the beneficiary sheet with her wording. This is about fuel money, not the eviction that's already been dealt with."
„Owen kann die falsche Druckzeile erkenn: "Owen can spot the wrong print line, Clara knows her own text. Then we'll look at the Old Market for who ordered the second stack. If you have to go away, I at least want to know what's on my slips."

„Sein Zeichnungsbuch liegt am Nachtmarkt: "His subscription book is at the Night Market. At the station you can check whether the supposed licence exists. After that we only need to agree on how to use the money."
„Sieh dir die Schabspuren auf dem Abzug: "Look at the scrape marks on the print, then the order at the estate desk of Villa Ashcombe and Tern's deposited note at the station. Connect the later retouch with his own wish in your notebook."
„Unter meinem Kartenbrett steckt ein neu: "Under my card board there's a new lead print. Look at it and check the inventory at the Night Market. After that I want to know whether I may still touch the cards."
